_comment: Voice-over of the final film, word for word from HACKATHON-VIDEO-SCRIPT.md (v3). One TTS file per id. 'sub' splits a line into subtitle cards with '|'. lang uz lines are read by an Uzbek neural voice and carry an English subtitle.

lines.text: Our dispatchers run a hundred and twenty trucks.
lines.sub: Our dispatchers run 120 trucks.

lines.text: Typing one rate confirmation takes them five to ten minutes. A CDL, two or three. And a missing POD can slip by unnoticed.
lines.sub: Typing one rate confirmation takes them 5 to 10 minutes.|A CDL, two or three.|And a missing POD can slip by unnoticed.

lines.text: So we put Meta Muse inside our TMS, as an agent that does the hunting, and the clicking, for them.
lines.sub: So we put Meta Muse inside our TMS —|as an agent that does the hunting, and the clicking, for them.

lines.text: Why can't load forty-one seventeen be invoiced?
lines.sub: Why can't load 4117 be invoiced?

lines.text: Muse checks: the proof of delivery is missing.
lines.sub: Muse checks: the proof of delivery is missing.

lines.text: I switch from Dry run to Live, and say: fix it.
lines.sub: I switch from Dry run to Live and say: fix it.

lines.text: Muse drives the app itself. Opens the documents, finds the driver, writes the message...
lines.sub: Muse drives the app itself —|opens the documents, finds the driver, writes the message…

lines.text: and stops to ask before it presses Send.
lines.sub: …and stops to ask before it presses Send.

lines.text: I allow it. Sent.
lines.sub: I allow it. Sent.

lines.text: Nothing risky happens without a person saying yes.
lines.sub: Nothing risky happens without a person saying yes.

lines.text: Every load starts with a rate confirmation.
lines.sub: Every load starts with a rate confirmation.

lines.text: Drop the PDF. Muse fills broker, three stops, reefer temperature and rate, in about seven seconds. Work that takes a dispatcher five to ten minutes.
lines.sub: Drop the PDF — Muse fills broker, three stops,|reefer temperature and rate in about seven seconds —|work that takes a dispatcher 5 to 10 minutes.

lines.text: Hiring: Muse reads a new driver's CDL in six seconds instead of two or three minutes, and catches that the birth date doesn't match his application.
lines.sub: Hiring: Muse reads a new driver's CDL in 6 seconds instead of 2 or 3 minutes —|and catches that the birth date doesn't match his application.

lines.text: Most of our drivers speak Uzbek or Russian first. This one just asks out loud.
lines.sub: Most of our drivers speak Uzbek or Russian first.|This one just asks out loud.

lines.text: Meta's transcription model doesn't know Uzbek. But Muse Spark understood the audio directly, checked his load, and answered him in Uzbek.
lines.sub: Meta's transcription model doesn't know Uzbek —|but Muse Spark understood the audio directly,|checked his load, and answered him in Uzbek.

lines.text: Keyingi pikap L-4114, Charlotte, bugun kunduzi soat 4:09 da, Eastern vaqti bilan. Yuk masofasi 405 mil.
lines.sub: Your next pickup: L-4114, Charlotte, today at 4:09 PM Eastern.|The load is 405 miles.

lines.text: Friday, payroll: Muse prepares every driver's statement, and flags what looks wrong, before anyone gets paid.
lines.sub: Friday, payroll: Muse prepares every driver's statement|and flags what looks wrong — before anyone gets paid.

lines.text: And every morning, Muse checks the whole fleet on its own: a load running late, expired papers, and a truck that bought more fuel in an hour than its tanks can hold.
lines.sub: And every morning, Muse checks the whole fleet on its own:|a load running late, expired papers,|and a truck that bought more fuel in an hour than its tanks can hold.

lines.text: Muse never touches the database. It calls our own tools with the user's own permissions. Dry run is on by default, risky presses ask first, and every write is audited.
lines.sub: Muse never touches the database.|It calls our own tools with the user's own permissions,|Dry run is on by default, risky presses ask first,|and every write is audited.

lines.text: Built in thirty hours, on a TMS that already runs two real trucking companies.
lines.sub: Built in thirty hours on a TMS|that already runs two real trucking companies.

lines.text: Rate confirmations: five to ten minutes, down to seven seconds. CDL checks: two or three minutes, down to six seconds.
lines.sub: Rate confirmations: 5 to 10 minutes down to 7 seconds.|CDL checks: 2 or 3 minutes down to 6 seconds.

lines.text: Next: dispatchers spend the whole shift searching for loads. So our next update is a load marketplace, where Muse matches empty trucks with freight. NeWay.
lines.sub: Next: dispatchers spend the whole shift searching for loads —|so our next update is a load marketplace where Muse matches empty trucks with freight.|NeWay.

lines.text: A hundred and twenty trucks. Meet the agent inside our TMS.
lines.sub: 120 trucks. Meet the agent inside our TMS.

lines.text: Muse finds the missing POD, messages the driver, and asks before it presses Send.
lines.sub: Muse finds the missing POD, messages the driver,|and asks before it presses Send.

lines.text: A rate confirmation in, the load filled in seven seconds.
lines.sub: A rate confirmation in — the load filled in 7 seconds.

lines.text: Drivers ask in Uzbek. Muse understands.
lines.sub: Drivers ask in Uzbek. Muse understands.

lines.text: NeWay AI, powered by Meta Muse.
lines.sub: NeWay AI, powered by Meta Muse.
